paragraphs: An E. coli O145 outbreak linked to frozen blueberries is now over, according to an update this week [1]. The outbreak affected 17 people across two states, with six hospitalizations and no deaths [1].

Walker's Wine Juice LLC is recalling pumpkin juice due to possible botulism contamination, which can cause weakness, dizziness, double vision, and trouble speaking or swallowing [10]. Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. is recalling Starfish Seafood Trio cold-smoked salmon, halibut, and trout packages because they may contain Listeria monocytogenes [4]. Oliva LLC is recalling Riad's Oliva to Go Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus due to undeclared sesame, a serious concern for people with sesame allergies [3].

Two separate recalls involve sprouting seeds with possible Salmonella contamination: Gardeners Basics is recalling one-pound bags of Waltham 29 broccoli sprouting seeds [5], and Eden Brothers LLC is recalling Calabrese Broccoli Seeds in one-ounce and one-pound packet sizes [6]. LEASA Industries Co. Inc. of Miami is recalling alfalfa sprouts due to possible E. coli contamination [16]. The USDA also issued a public health alert for 140-gram cans of Grace Ready to Eat Chicken Vienna Sausages that were illegally imported from Jamaica and found in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, and Texas [2].
